server: uv run uvicorn autotester.ui.app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8033, run from the worktree with AUTOTESTER_ROOT pointed at a seeded scratch root
seed: project 'demo' + run 'run_ui_demo' with trace.jsonl written via the unit's own core.trace.TraceWriter (one StageSpan, one LLMSpan), LLMSpan.fed_id deliberately built from a real secret value bound to a populated Redactor to prove the UI never surfaces it
note: This seed used an explicitly-populated Redactor passed to TraceWriter, matching the unit's own tests -- NOT the default StageContext auto-wiring (which the checker separately proved leaves the Redactor empty, see VERDICT). The UI panel itself is a correct read-only view over trace.jsonl; the redaction gap is upstream of this page, in how TraceWriter is constructed when a run is actually driven end to end.
